zh: AdamW moments、learning-rate schedule、global batch 与 gradient clipping 共同决定实际 parameter update
optimizer、sampler 与 step/token counter 都属于可恢复训练状态
数据 mixture、去重和重复 epoch 改变不同能力与风险获得的 gradient 权重
compute-optimal average loss 不等于最佳 Agent 行为或最低 serving 成本
en: AdamW moments, the learning-rate schedule, global batch, and gradient clipping jointly determine each parameter update
Optimizer, sampler, and step or token counters all belong to recoverable training state
Data mixtures, deduplication, and repeated epochs change the gradient weight given to capabilities and risks
Compute-optimal average loss is not equivalent to the best agent behavior or lowest serving cost

next.zh: 进入 sampling：temperature、greedy、top-k、top-p、seed 与 constrained decoding 怎样从同一 logits 产生不同 Agent 行为，以及 determinism 的真实边界。
next.en: Move into sampling: how temperature, greedy decoding, top-k, top-p, seeds, and constrained decoding turn the same logits into different agent behavior, and the real boundary of determinism.
